messages.subject: Different Colors For Individual Facet Backgrounds
parts:
Hi!

 

I can change the color of all facet label backgrounds using:

 

opts(strip.background = theme_rect(fill = "blue"))

 

but the naive approach to my question:

 

opts(strip.background = theme_rect(fill = c("blue",”green”,”red”,”yellow”)))

 

doesn’t do as expected (i.e., give each of my four facet groups a different color) instead the first color “blue” is taken and used for all four (with no warning)

 

Is it possible to do what I am trying?

 

Version: 0.9.1

 

I can cobble together a minimal working example but hopefully the description will be enough…

 

Thanks!

 

Dave
